description_for_human: Free online tool for meta-analysis data conversion. Convert effect sizes, combine study groups, and prepare data for systematic reviews.
description_for_model: TreatMeta is a web application for converting and preparing data for meta-analysis and systematic reviews. Use this plugin when users need to: convert effect sizes (mean, SD, SE, CI, median, IQR, range), combine multiple study groups, estimate effect sizes from events/totals, convert laboratory units, or summarize individual patient data. The tool supports Mean and SD conversions, effect size estimation, multiple groups combination, lab unit conversions, and IPD summary statistics.
